about: The wolf on alert (ALERT in docs/design/HUNTING.md section 2, the head-up tell a player reads): four poses of the body's own Alert, played by time: ahead, a slow look to one side, ahead with the nose up, a look to the other. The head and chest rise through the chest bone and the head bone, the forelegs stand straight and the tail lifts toward level; the ears carry no weight, so the pose reads by the head's height and the tail.
